papers.title: IrrEM (Irrigation in the eastern Mediterranean): Two and a half decades of seasonal high-resolution irrigated land maps of the eastern Mediterranean
papers.authors: Adrah, E., Brocca, L., Senkardesler, E., et al.
papers.approach: Landsat-based OPTRAM relative soil moisture with irrigation-induced change detection
papers.summary: The study maps summer and winter irrigated land at 30 m resolution across the eastern Mediterranean for 26 years using Landsat-derived soil moisture.

papers.title: Inferring groundwater overdraft in data-scarce arid agro-ecosystems: a semi-empirical remote sensing framework applied to the Elfeija watershed, Morocco
papers.authors: Amiha, R., Kabbachi, B., Haddou, M.A., et al.
papers.approach: Semi-empirical thermal-phenological model using NDVI and LST anomalies, with Monte Carlo uncertainty
papers.summary: Uses Sentinel-2 and Landsat thermal data to infer unmetered groundwater pumping for irrigation in a Moroccan watershed and assess overdraft risk for 2020–2024.

papers.title: A semi-supervised multi-sensor remote sensing pipeline for mapping irrigation dynamics in ground-truth deficient conflict zones: a case study of the Kakhovka Dam failure
papers.authors: Baber, S., Skakun, S.V., Sadeh, Y., et al.
papers.domain: Kherson and Zaporizhzhia oblasts, Ukraine (Kakhovka Dam failure)
papers.approach: Semi-supervised machine learning pipeline fusing Sentinel-2, Landsat, CHIRPS and WaPOR data
papers.summary: The study maps irrigated cropland in southern Ukraine before and after the 2023 Kakhovka Dam failure using semi-supervised machine learning on multi-sensor satellite data.

papers.title: Incorporating irrigation effects into high-resolution daily land evaporation estimates over the Iberian Peninsula
papers.authors: Baez-Villanueva, O. M., Crespo-Otero, A., Modanesi, S., et al.
papers.approach: Explicit irrigation added to GLEAM4 evaporation model at 1 km
papers.summary: Adds explicit irrigation to the GLEAM4 evaporation model at 1 km over Iberia; irrigation raises evaporation by up to about 450 mm per year over irrigated land.
papers.note: Estimates irrigation-driven evaporation, not the amount of water applied.

papers.title: Regionalising a global gridded crop model using satellite-based phenology for water footprint analysis in the Upper Syr Darya Basin
papers.authors: Baviskar, G.i., Foster, T., Hogeboom, R.J., et al.
papers.domain: Upper Syr Darya Basin, Central Asia
papers.approach: Regionalised global gridded crop model (AquaCrop-Earth@lternatives) with satellite-derived phenology
papers.summary: Regionalises a global crop model's cotton calendar using satellite phenology, showing that planting and season length changes alter simulated evapotranspiration and blue water footprints in the Upper Syr Darya Basin.

papers.title: On the gap between crop and land surface models: comparing irrigation and other land surface estimates from AquaCrop and Noah-MP over the Po Valley
papers.authors: Busschaert, L., Bechtold, M., Modanesi, S., et al.
papers.approach: AquaCrop and Noah-MP sprinkler irrigation simulations in NASA LIS
papers.summary: Compares 1 km irrigation from AquaCrop and Noah-MP over the Po Valley; Noah-MP simulates about 434 mm/yr versus 268 mm/yr, mainly because of larger water losses.
papers.note: First posted as an EGUsphere preprint in July 2025.

papers.title: Remote sensing-based mapping of flood irrigation extent and depth during fallow periods in arid irrigation district
papers.authors: Chen, X., Shang, S.
papers.approach: Improved optical trapezoid model (OPTRAM) on Sentinel-2; band-based regression for irrigation depth
papers.summary: Maps spring flood-irrigated cropland extent in Hetao Irrigation District from 2016 to 2023 using an improved OPTRAM on Sentinel-2, and estimates autumn and spring irrigation depths.

papers.title: Satellite‐Based Estimates of Irrigation Water Use Versus Modeling Reconstructions: How Much do They Differ?
papers.authors: Dari, J., Brocca, L., Laluet, P., et al.
papers.domain: CONUS, Ebro basin (Spain), India, Murray-Darling basin (Australia)
papers.approach: Intercomparison of satellite soil-moisture inversion and delta IWU estimates against five global hyd
papers.summary: Compares satellite-based irrigation water use estimates with five global hydrological model reconstructions across four irrigation hotspots, finding satellite products better matched reference data over the Ebro basin.

papers.title: IWU-SMinv v1.0 and v1.1: Two satellite-based irrigation water use datasets at 1 km spatial resolution over Europe
papers.authors: Dari, J., Singh, Y.K.B., Ntokas, K., et al.
papers.approach: Satellite soil moisture based inversion of irrigation water use
papers.summary: Presents two satellite-based datasets estimating irrigation water use at 1 km resolution across Europe, derived from soil moisture observations.

papers.title: Delineation of irrigated croplands and spatial analysis of crop water use for water resource management in the Orange River valley, Northern Cape
papers.authors: Dube, T.J., Sechemane, N.
papers.venue: Physics and Chemistry of the Earth Parts A/B/C
papers.domain: Orange River valley around Upington, Northern Cape, South Africa
papers.approach: Random Forest irrigated cropland mapping; SEBS energy-balance ET validated against Penman-Monteith
papers.summary: Maps irrigated croplands in the Orange River valley with Sentinel-2 Random Forest and estimates crop evapotranspiration with SEBS and Landsat 8 for 2022–2024, finding weak daily agreement with reference ET.

papers.title: SWOT Ka-Radar and ICESat-2 Altimetry Fusion for Satellite-Constrained Irrigation Water Balance: Evidence from the World's Largest Gravity-Fed Scheme
papers.authors: Dumpati, S.M.
papers.approach: Fusion of SWOT and ICESat-2 water levels with water balance modelling
papers.summary: Combines SWOT and ICESat-2 water-level measurements with evapotranspiration, groundwater and precipitation data to estimate gravity-fed irrigation delivery and canal efficiency in Sudan's Gezira scheme.

papers.title: Irrigation Dynamics Inside and Outside Official Irrigation Systems in Galați County, Romania: A Satellite-Based Assessment (2017–2025)
papers.authors: Florea, A., Radu, R.I., Bercu, A.P.C., et al.
papers.approach: Random Forest classification of multitemporal Sentinel-2 and Landsat imagery, compared with administ
papers.summary: Annual maps of irrigated area in Galați County, Romania, from 2017 to 2025 were produced with Random Forest on Sentinel-2 and Landsat imagery and checked against official irrigation reports.

papers.title: Alternate Wetting and Drying Irrigated Rice Paddy Field Water Status Monitoring with ALOS-2 Three Components and IoT Sensors
papers.authors: Islam, M.R., Oyoshi, K., Takeuchi, W.
papers.approach: Freeman-Durden decomposition of PALSAR-2 polarimetry with Random Forest classification
papers.summary: Uses L-band PALSAR-2 polarimetric decomposition and IoT water-level sensors with Random Forest to classify alternate wetting and drying versus continuous flooding in rice paddies in Bangladesh.

papers.title: Characterization of irrigation timing using thermal satellite observations, a data-driven approach
papers.authors: Jalilvand, E., Kumar, S.V., Truong, C., Haacker, E., Mahanama, S.
papers.approach: Data-driven detection of irrigation timing from thermal observations (AgroTrack)
papers.summary: Introduces AgroTrack, a data-driven method that infers where and when fields are irrigated from thermal satellite observations; it captured widespread fallowing after California's 2021 drought.

papers.title: Satellite data rendered irrigation using Penman–Monteith and SEBAL – sDRIPS for surface water irrigation optimization
papers.authors: Khan, S., Hossain, F., Islam, K., et al.
papers.approach: Weekly canal irrigation advisories from SEBAL and Penman-Monteith ET
papers.summary: Estimates weekly net irrigation water requirements for canal command areas from satellite evapotranspiration and rainfall forecasts, co-developed with Bangladesh's water agency for the Teesta scheme.

papers.title: Long-term irrigation water use datasets from multiple Earth Observation-based methods in major irrigated regions
papers.authors: Laluet, P., Dari, J., Busschaert, L., et al.
papers.domain: CONUS, India, Murray-Darling and Ebro basins
papers.approach: Monthly 0.25-degree irrigation from soil-moisture methods and Noah-MP
papers.summary: Releases monthly 0.25-degree irrigation water use datasets from several satellite soil moisture-based methods and Noah-MP for four major irrigated regions, evaluated against survey and basin data.
papers.note: First posted as an ESSD discussion paper in January 2026.

papers.title: Detecting irrigation from spectral differences between satellite and modeled soil moisture across the contiguous United States
papers.authors: Massari, C., Modanesi, S., Heyvaert, Z., et al.
papers.approach: Wavelet comparison of SMOS and irrigation-free Noah-MP soil moisture
papers.summary: Maps irrigated areas across the contiguous US from seasonal and sub-seasonal spectral differences between SMOS soil moisture and Noah-MP runs without irrigation.
papers.note: First posted on EarthArXiv in March 2026 under the title 'Spectral signatures in satellite soil moisture reveal irrigation patterns across the contiguous United States'.

papers.title: Assessing Hydrological Model Representation of Irrigation and Subsurface Flow in a Heavily Anthropogenic‐Influenced Catchment
papers.authors: Mendoza, R., Verseveld, W.J.v., Weiland, F.S., et al.
papers.approach: wflow_sbm hydrological model with three remote-sensing-based irrigation calendars and two subsurface
papers.summary: Compares how three remote-sensing-derived irrigation calendars and two subsurface flow concepts change simulated discharge, evapotranspiration and groundwater in a wflow_sbm model of the Hindon River Basin.

papers.title: An integrated satellite remote sensing approach for mapping field-scale irrigation dynamics to support water management in highly regulated semi-arid catchments
papers.authors: Muturi, J.W., Majumdar, S., Ndehedehe, C.E., et al.
papers.domain: Namoi catchment, New South Wales, Australia
papers.approach: Thresholding of ET0 fraction and EVI to separate irrigated from rainfed fields
papers.summary: The study maps irrigated cropland in the Namoi catchment from 2019 to 2025 using an ET0 fraction and EVI thresholding approach, validated against 40 fields with moderate accuracy.

papers.title: Agricultural water balance and variability in Utah irrigation canal companies with OpenET products and spatial data
papers.authors: Osorio-Diaz, K., Torres‐Rua, A.F., Yost, M.A., et al.
papers.domain: Northern Utah, USA (three irrigation canal companies)
papers.approach: Monthly root-zone water balance using OpenET ET and gridMET, Random Forest for depletion
papers.summary: Coupling OpenET satellite evapotranspiration and gridMET weather data with diversion records, the study estimates monthly water balance residuals for three Utah canal companies in 2020–2023.

papers.title: Irrigation quantification through ensemble physical modelling
papers.authors: Paciolla, N., Polletta, M.C., Morari, F., et al.
papers.domain: Italy (field case studies, semi-arid to wet climates)
papers.approach: Monte Carlo ensemble of irrigation schedules in energy-water balance model, compared to observations
data: In-situ soil moisture and ET measurement
papers.summary: A Monte Carlo ensemble method infers irrigation timing and volume by comparing simulated soil moisture, ET and land surface temperature with ground and satellite references at Italian field sites.

papers.title: Irrigation Use in a Changing Landscape: A Combined Economic and Hydrologic Approach
papers.authors: Rizwan, N., Jalali, J., Sears, M., et al.
papers.approach: Econometric field-level irrigation choice model coupled with SWAT+ hydrological modeling
papers.summary: Combines an econometric model of farmers' irrigation choices with SWAT+ simulations to project irrigation expansion and water balance effects in Serbia under future climate scenarios.

papers.title: Remote sensing-based assessment of long-term evapotranspiration and irrigation performance following modernization of Andalusian irrigation districts
papers.authors: Rodríguez-Álvarez, J.A., Mateos, L., Egea, G.
papers.approach: Google Earth Engine framework with vegetation-index crop coefficients and SSEBop actual ET
papers.summary: Satellite-based framework in Google Earth Engine tracks evapotranspiration and irrigation adequacy across 49 Andalusian districts from 2004 to 2019, finding diverging potential and actual water use after modernization.

papers.title: Adaptive Unsupervised Detection of Field-Scale Irrigation from High-Resolution SAR Soil Moisture Maps
papers.authors: Rossi, S., Balenzano, A., Palmisano, D., et al.
papers.domain: Riaza irrigation district, Castilla y León, Spain
papers.approach: CFAR adaptive unsupervised thresholding on high-resolution SAR soil moisture maps
papers.summary: Uses Sentinel-1 and Sentinel-2 derived soil moisture with a CFAR algorithm to detect field-scale irrigation events and estimate irrigated area in a Spanish district.

papers.title: Detecting irrigation signals from SMAP L3 and L4 soil moisture: A case study in California's Central Valley
papers.authors: Huang, X., He, Q., Hanasaki, N., et al.
papers.approach: Cropping versus non-cropping season SMAP L3 minus L4 differences
papers.summary: Maps relative irrigation intensity from differences between SMAP Level 3 retrievals and the Level 4 assimilation product, which excludes irrigation; correlations of 0.66 and 0.50 with benchmark maps.

papers.title: Regional data sets of high-resolution (1 and 6 km) irrigation estimates from space
papers.authors: Dari, J., Brocca, L., Modanesi, S., et al.
papers.domain: Ebro basin, Po valley and Murray–Darling basin
papers.approach: Soil-moisture-based inversion of Sentinel-1 and CYGNSS soil moisture
papers.summary: Releases weekly irrigation-amount datasets at 1 km (Ebro, Po) and 6 km (Murray–Darling) from satellite soil moisture inversion, evaluated against district-level irrigation benchmarks.

papers.title: Is it possible to quantify irrigation water-use by assimilating a high-resolution satellite soil moisture product?
papers.authors: Jalilvand, E., Abolafia-Rosenzweig, R., Tajrishy, M., Kumar, S.V., Mohammadi, M.R., Das, N.N.
papers.approach: Particle batch smoother assimilation of 1 km soil moisture into VIC
papers.summary: Assimilating 1 km SMAP/Sentinel-1 soil moisture estimated irrigation well when timing was known, but underestimated observed water use by 18.6% in real-world tests.

papers.title: The precision of satellite-based net irrigation quantification in the Indus and Ganges basins
papers.authors: Kragh, S. J., Fensholt, R., Stisen, S., et al.
papers.approach: Ensemble of satellite ET minus rainfed mHM ET
papers.summary: Uses 15 combinations of ET and precipitation products with a rainfed mHM baseline to quantify net irrigation and its precision in the Indus and Ganges basins.

papers.title: Irrigation timing retrieval at the plot scale using surface soil moisture derived from Sentinel time series in Europe
papers.authors: Le Page, M., Nguyen, T., Zribi, M., et al.
papers.domain: Five sites in France, Germany and Italy
papers.approach: Sentinel soil moisture compared with bucket and force-restore models
papers.summary: Retrieves plot-scale irrigation timing in Europe from Sentinel soil moisture; detection weakens with sparser observations and frequent irrigation, and a force-restore model raised F-scores by about 6 points.

papers.title: Challenges and benefits of quantifying irrigation through the assimilation of Sentinel-1 backscatter observations into Noah-MP
papers.authors: Modanesi, S., Massari, C., Bechtold, M., et al.
papers.domain: Po Valley, Italy, and Lower Saxony, Germany
papers.approach: EnKF assimilation of Sentinel-1 backscatter into Noah-MP irrigation scheme
papers.summary: Assimilates Sentinel-1 backscatter into Noah-MP with a sprinkler scheme; results are mixed and limited by the irrigation parameterization.

papers.title: How accurately can we retrieve irrigation timing and water amounts from (satellite) soil moisture?
papers.authors: Zappa, L., Schlaffer, S., Brocca, L., et al.
papers.venue: International Journal of Applied Earth Observation and Geoinformation
papers.domain: Four center-pivot fields, Germany, plus synthetic experiment
papers.approach: Synthetic and real tests of soil moisture resolution and revisit
papers.summary: Tests how soil moisture resolution, revisit time and noise limit irrigation retrieval; detection and quantification work with data every 3 days or better, while random errors hurt most.

papers.title: Estimation of global irrigation water use by the integration of multiple satellite observations
papers.authors: Zhang, K., Li, X., Zheng, D., et al.
papers.approach: Multi-satellite soil moisture water balance with PT-JPL ET
papers.summary: Combines several satellite soil moisture and precipitation products in a process-based framework to estimate global irrigation water use, evaluated against US, Chinese and FAO statistics.

papers.title: Detecting and mapping irrigated areas in a Mediterranean environment by using remote sensing soil moisture and a land surface model
papers.authors: Dari, J., Quintana-Seguí, P., Escorihuela, M.J., et al.
papers.approach: K-means clustering of satellite and modelled soil moisture
papers.summary: Compares five satellite soil moisture products for detecting irrigation in northeast Spain and maps irrigated areas by K-means clustering, with downscaled SMAP agreeing up to 78%.

papers.title: Evaluation of SMAP/Sentinel 1 high-resolution soil moisture data to detect irrigation over agricultural domain
papers.authors: Jalilvand, E., Abolafia-Rosenzweig, R., Tajrishy, M., Das, N.N.
papers.venue: IEEE Journal of Selected Topics in Applied Earth Observations and Remote Sensing
papers.domain: Irrigated plain south of Lake Urmia, Iran
papers.approach: Mean and variability of SMAP and SMAP/Sentinel-1 soil moisture
papers.summary: The 9 km SMAP product misses irrigation, but 1–3 km SMAP/Sentinel-1 data show it in soil moisture variability, especially with dynamic vegetation water content.

papers.title: Irrigation amounts and timing retrieval through data assimilation of surface soil moisture into the FAO-56 approach in the South Mediterranean region
papers.authors: Ouaadi, N., Jarlan, L., Khabba, S., et al.
papers.domain: Wheat fields, Haouz plain, central Morocco
papers.approach: Particle filter assimilating surface soil moisture into FAO-56
papers.summary: Assimilates surface soil moisture into FAO-56 with a particle filter to retrieve irrigation timing and amounts on Moroccan wheat; Sentinel-1 data gave good seasonal totals.

papers.title: A method to estimate surface soil moisture and map the irrigated cropland area using Sentinel-1 and Sentinel-2 data
papers.authors: Rabiei, S., Jalilvand, E., Tajrishy, M.
papers.domain: Farms in Tehran and Alborz provinces, Iran
papers.approach: CNN soil moisture from Sentinel-1/2, then irrigated-area classification
papers.summary: Estimates 10 m surface soil moisture with a neural network, then maps irrigated cropland from it with 77% overall accuracy.

papers.title: Mapping annual irrigation from Landsat imagery and environmental variables across the conterminous United States
papers.authors: Xie, Y., Lark, T.J.
papers.approach: County-stratified random forests on Landsat and environmental variables
papers.summary: Produces 30 m annual irrigation maps for the conterminous US from 1997 to 2017 using Landsat, environmental variables and county-stratified random forest classifiers.

papers.title: Detection and quantification of irrigation water amounts at 500 m using Sentinel-1 surface soil moisture
papers.authors: Zappa, L., Schlaffer, S., Bauer-Marschallinger, B., et al.
papers.approach: Event detection and water-balance quantification from Sentinel-1 soil moisture
data: TU Wien S1 surface soil moisture
papers.summary: Detects field-scale irrigation events and estimates water amounts from 500 m Sentinel-1 soil moisture, agreeing with farmer-reported timing and patterns in Germany.

papers.title: Near real-time irrigation detection at plot scale using Sentinel-1 data
papers.authors: Bazzi, H., Baghdadi, N., Fayad, I., et al.
papers.approach: Decision tree on Sentinel-1 backscatter change detection
papers.summary: Detects plot-scale irrigation events in near real time from Sentinel-1 backscatter changes, using coarse soil moisture to screen out rain; 84.8% of events detected at Montpellier.

papers.title: Irrigation events detection over intensively irrigated grassland plots using Sentinel-1 data
papers.authors: Bazzi, H., Baghdadi, N., Fayad, I., et al.
papers.domain: Grassland plots, Crau plain, southeastern France
papers.approach: Change detection on Sentinel-1 VV and VH backscatter
papers.summary: Detects irrigation events on 46 intensively irrigated grassland plots from Sentinel-1 backscatter time series; combining VV and VH gave the best F-score (76.4%).

papers.title: Exploiting high-resolution remote sensing soil moisture to estimate irrigation water amounts over a Mediterranean region
papers.authors: Dari, J., Brocca, L., Quintana-Seguí, P., et al.
papers.approach: SM2RAIN inversion of 1 km downscaled satellite soil moisture
papers.summary: Applies SM2RAIN with crop evapotranspiration to 1 km DISPATCH-downscaled SMAP and SMOS soil moisture, reproducing irrigation amounts in four of five Ebro districts.

papers.title: IrrMapper: A machine learning approach for high resolution mapping of irrigated agriculture across the Western U.S.
papers.authors: Ketchum, D., Jencso, K., Maneta, M.P., et al.
papers.approach: Random forest classification of Landsat and ancillary data in GEE
papers.summary: Produces annual 30 m irrigated land maps for 11 western US states from 1986 to 2018 using Landsat and random forest, with 97.8% irrigated versus unirrigated accuracy.

papers.title: Estimating net irrigation across the North China Plain through dual modeling of evapotranspiration
papers.authors: Koch, J., Zhang, W., Martinsen, G., et al.
papers.domain: Haihe River Basin and North China Plain
papers.approach: Remote sensing ET minus rainfed hydrologic model ET
papers.summary: Estimates monthly 1 km net irrigation as the residual between remote sensing ET and a hydrologic model without irrigation, about 126 mm/yr over the North China Plain.

papers.title: Potential for the detection of irrigation events on maize plots using Sentinel-1 soil moisture products
papers.authors: Le Page, M., Jarlan, L., El Hajj, M., et al.
papers.approach: Sentinel-1 soil moisture changes compared with water balance simulations
papers.summary: Tests whether irrigation events on maize plots can be detected from Sentinel-1 soil moisture changes; detection reached F-scores around 80 with observations every 2-4 days.

papers.title: Irrigation retrieval from Landsat optical/thermal data integrated into a crop water balance model: A case study over winter wheat fields in a semi-arid region
papers.authors: Olivera-Guerra, L., Merlin, O., Er-Raki, S.
papers.approach: Landsat thermal water stress constrains FAO-56 crop water balance
papers.summary: Uses a Landsat thermal-derived crop water stress coefficient within a FAO-56 water balance to retrieve irrigation on Moroccan wheat; seasonal amounts agreed well, daily estimates less so.

papers.title: Soil moisture data assimilation to estimate irrigation water use
papers.authors: Abolafia-Rosenzweig, R., Livneh, B., Small, E. E., et al.
papers.venue: Journal of Advances in Modeling Earth Systems
papers.approach: Particle batch smoother assimilation of soil moisture (synthetic experiments)
papers.summary: Synthetic experiments show a particle batch smoother assimilating SMAP-like soil moisture into a land surface model can estimate daily to seasonal irrigation amounts.

papers.title: Mapping irrigated areas using Sentinel-1 time series in Catalonia, Spain
papers.authors: Bazzi, H., Baghdadi, N., Ienco, D., et al.
papers.approach: Random forest and CNN on Sentinel-1 backscatter time series
papers.summary: Classifies irrigated and non-irrigated plots in western Catalonia from Sentinel-1 backscatter time series, with a convolutional neural network reaching about 94% accuracy.

papers.title: Mapping three decades of annual irrigation across the US High Plains Aquifer using Landsat and Google Earth Engine
papers.authors: Deines, J.M., Kendall, A.D., Crowley, M.A., et al.
papers.approach: Random forest with Bayesian (BULC) gap-filling in Google Earth Engine
papers.summary: Maps annual 30 m irrigated area across the High Plains Aquifer for 1984–2017 using Landsat, random forest and Bayesian updating, reaching about 91% accuracy.

papers.title: Quantification of irrigation water using remote sensing of soil moisture in a semi-arid region
papers.authors: Jalilvand, E., Tajrishy, M., Ghazi Zadeh Hashemi, S.A., Brocca, L.
papers.domain: Agricultural plains south of Lake Urmia, Iran
papers.approach: SM2RAIN inversion of coarse satellite soil moisture
papers.summary: Adapts SM2RAIN to estimate monthly irrigation from AMSR2 soil moisture, reaching R = 0.86 against in situ irrigation data after bias correction.

papers.title: Estimating irrigation water use over the contiguous United States by combining satellite and reanalysis soil moisture data
papers.authors: Zaussinger, F., Dorigo, W., Gruber, A., et al.
papers.approach: Satellite minus irrigation-free reanalysis soil moisture differences
papers.summary: Derives monthly irrigation water use across CONUS from differences between satellite soil moisture and MERRA-2 reanalysis without irrigation; state totals correlate with but underestimate reported withdrawals.

papers.title: How much water is used for irrigation? A new approach exploiting coarse resolution satellite soil moisture products
papers.authors: Brocca, L., Tarpanelli, A., Filippucci, P., et al.
papers.venue: International Journal of Applied Earth Observation and Geoinformation
papers.domain: Nine pilot sites in Europe, USA, Australia and Africa
papers.approach: Soil water balance inversion (SM2RAIN) of satellite soil moisture
papers.summary: Inverts the soil water balance using coarse-resolution satellite soil moisture to estimate irrigation water applied, tested with synthetic experiments and at nine pilot sites.

papers.title: Utilizing SMAP soil moisture data to constrain irrigation in the Community Land Model
papers.authors: Felfelani, F., Pokhrel, Y., Guan, K., et al.
papers.approach: SMAP soil moisture assimilation constraining CLM4.5 irrigation targets
papers.summary: Assimilating SMAP soil moisture to constrain CLM4.5 irrigation target soil moisture roughly halved errors in simulated irrigation water requirement in Nebraska, Kansas and Texas.

papers.title: Irrigation mapping using Sentinel-1 time series at field scale
papers.authors: Gao, Q., Zribi, M., Escorihuela, M.J., et al.
papers.approach: SVM and random forest on Sentinel-1 time-series metrics
papers.summary: Uses field-averaged Sentinel-1 backscatter time-series metrics and SVM to separate irrigated crops, irrigated trees and non-irrigated fields in Urgell, Catalonia, with about 81% accuracy.

papers.title: A global approach to estimate irrigated areas – a comparison between different data and statistics
papers.authors: Meier, J., Zabel, F., Mauser, W.
papers.approach: Decision tree combining NDVI time series and agricultural suitability
papers.summary: Maps global irrigated area at 30 arcsec from NDVI time series and agricultural suitability data, finding about 18% more irrigated land than statistics-based maps.

papers.title: Global 5 km resolution estimates of secondary evaporation including irrigation through satellite data assimilation
papers.authors: van Dijk, A. I. J. M., Schellekens, J., Yebra, M., et al.
papers.approach: MODIS data assimilation into W3 global hydrological model
papers.summary: Assimilates MODIS observations into a global hydrological model to estimate secondary evaporation and a minimum irrigation water requirement of about 680 km³/yr.

papers.title: Annual irrigation dynamics in the US Northern High Plains derived from Landsat satellite data
papers.authors: Deines, J.M., Kendall, A.D., Hyndman, D.W.
papers.approach: Random forest on Landsat with greenness-moisture indices in GEE
papers.summary: Maps annual 30 m irrigated area in the US Northern High Plains for 1999–2016 with Landsat and random forests, linking yearly changes to precipitation and commodity prices.

papers.title: Irrigation signals detected from SMAP soil moisture retrievals
papers.authors: Lawston, P.M., Santanello, J.A., Kumar, S.V.
papers.domain: Irrigated regions of the United States
papers.approach: Comparing SMAP soil moisture over irrigated and non-irrigated areas
papers.summary: Shows that SMAP soil moisture retrievals can pick up the signature of irrigation over US agricultural regions.

papers.title: Remotely sensed high resolution irrigated area mapping in India for 2000 to 2015
papers.authors: Ambika, A.K., Wardlow, B., Mishra, V.
papers.approach: Annual MODIS NDVI-based mapping within agroecological zones
papers.summary: Provides 250 m annual irrigated area maps for India from 2000 to 2015 using MODIS NDVI and land cover data, evaluated against agricultural statistics.

papers.title: Water savings potentials of irrigation systems: global simulation of processes and linkages
papers.authors: Jägermeyr, J., Gerten, D., Heinke, J., et al.
papers.approach: Process-based surface, sprinkler and drip irrigation in LPJmL
papers.summary: Simulates global irrigation efficiency by system type in LPJmL, estimating 2469 km³ withdrawal and 1257 km³ consumption and potential savings from sprinkler and drip.

papers.title: Global rain-fed, irrigated, and paddy croplands: A new high resolution map derived from remote sensing, crop inventories and climate data
papers.authors: Salmon, J.M., Friedl, M.A., Frolking, S., et al.
papers.venue: International Journal of Applied Earth Observation and Geoinformation
papers.approach: Boosted decision tree classification with crop-inventory priors
papers.summary: Combines MODIS imagery, climate data and crop inventories to map rain-fed, irrigated and paddy croplands worldwide at 500 m for circa 2005.

papers.title: Global irrigated area map (GIAM), derived from remote sensing, for the end of the last millennium
papers.authors: Thenkabail, P.S., Biradar, C.M., Noojipady, P., et al.
papers.approach: Unsupervised classification of multi-sensor data cube with spectral matching
papers.summary: Produces a global irrigated area map for the late 1990s from AVHRR, SPOT VGT and ancillary data, estimating about 467 Mha of annualized irrigated area.

papers.title: A new methodology to map irrigated areas using multi-temporal MODIS and ancillary data: An application example in the continental US
papers.authors: Ozdogan, M., Gutman, G.
papers.approach: Climate index, MODIS signatures, supervised classification, regression trees
papers.summary: Maps irrigated cropland and sub-pixel irrigated fraction across the continental US for 2001 using multi-temporal MODIS data, climate data and a cultivated-area map.
